title: Filing The Fact (Kristen Is Brandon's Brother)
style: lo-fi desk-jazz, 92 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, brushed snare, upright bass, filing-cabinet drawer slide as percussion, soft male spoken-sung, library quiet
lyrics:
[Intro]
file open, pen down
new name in the kinship town

[Verse 1]
operator drops a line
says the brother's name this time
spelled with a K, not the way I'd guess
but that's the file, no more no less

[Pre-Chorus]
no questions back, no clarify
just log the link and let it lie

[Chorus]
file the fact, file it clean
brother of the brother, on the screen
don't correct, don't infer
that is what the records were
file the fact, file the fact
the operator said it, that's the pact

[Verse 2]
maybe spelled with an E or two
maybe it's a nickname true
doesn't matter, not my place
just the entry in the case

[Chorus]
file the fact, file it clean
brother of the brother, on the screen
don't correct, don't infer
that is what the records were
file the fact, file the fact
the operator said it, that's the pact

[Outro]
drawer slides shut, lights stay low
next fact comes, away we go
